values.name: Address ex delivery area
values.description: The address for delivery is outside the area of the carrier/transporter.

values.name: After transport departed
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment arrived after the means of transport has departed.

values.name: Agent refusal
values.description: The agent of the customer refused to accept delivery.

values.name: Altered seals
values.description: The seals on the equipment have been changed from those notified.

values.name: Appointment scheduled
values.description: An arrangement has been made to deliver at a specific time.

values.name: Attempt unsuccessful
values.description: An unsuccessful attempt has been made to deliver the goods/consignments/equipment.

values.name: Business closed
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment could not be delivered/collected as the business was closed.

values.name: Changed schedule
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment cannot/will not be delivered/collected at the arranged time because of a change of schedule.

values.name: Complementary address needed
values.description: A further address is needed to effect delivery/collection of the goods/consignments/equipment.

values.name: Computer system down
values.description: The computer system is inoperative.

values.name: Credit approval requested
values.description: The consignee requests delivery on a credit base.

values.name: Customer arrangements
values.description: Goods/consignments/equipment require delivery arrangements by the customer.

values.name: Customs refusal
values.description: The Customs authorities have refused to clear the goods/consignments/equipment.

values.name: Damaged
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been damaged.

values.name: Delivery at specific requested dates/times/periods
values.description: Delivery of the goods/consignments/equipment is requested at specific dates/times/periods.

values.name: Destination incorrect
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been sent to wrong destination.

values.name: Departure delay
values.description: The transport has been delayed in departing on the arranged transport action.

values.name: Derailment
values.description: The train carrying the goods/consignments/equipment has been derailed.

values.name: Discrepancy
values.description: There is a discrepancy between the details of goods/ equipment previously provided and the actual situation.

values.name: Dock strike
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment cannot be delivered/collected due to a dock strike.

values.name: Due to customer
values.description: An action in the transport chain has been affected due to action of the customer.

values.name: Empty
values.description: The package/equipment is found to be empty.

values.name: Equipment failure
values.description: Delivery/collection could not be effected due to equipment failure.

values.name: Examination required by relevant authority
values.description: An examination of the goods/equipment has been ordered by the relevant authority.

values.name: Export restrictions
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been prohibited from export pending further investigation.

values.name: Frustrated export
values.description: Attempts to export the goods/consignments/equipment have been unsuccessful.

values.name: Goods units missing
values.description: The tally of goods/consignments/equipment does not match the quantity as per advice. Result: less than advised.

values.name: Import restrictions
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment need import checks and tests pending being released for importation.

values.name: Incorrect pick information
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment were not collected due to incorrect pick information.

values.name: Incorrect address
values.description: The address given for the action was incorrect.

values.name: Industrial dispute
values.description: The action was frustrated by an industrial dispute.

values.name: Instructions awaited
values.description: Further instructions are required.

values.name: Lost goods/consignments/equipment
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been lost in the course of a movement along the transport chain.

values.name: Means of transport damaged
values.description: The means of transport on which the goods/consignments/equipment were being (were to be) moved has been  damaged.

values.name: Mechanical breakdown
values.description: There has been a mechanical breakdown of the means of transport/equipment on which the goods/consignments/equipment was being (was to be) moved.

values.name: Mechanical inspection
values.description: A mechanical inspection of the means of transport/ equipment on which the goods/consignments/equipment were being (were to be) moved, is required.

values.name: Missing and/or incorrect documents
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment require complete and correct documentation.

values.name: New delivery arrangements
values.description: Alternative delivery arrangements advised by consignee after failed delivery.

values.name: No recipient contact information
values.description: No information available concerning the responsible person at delivery address.

values.name: Not identified
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment expected to be located and identified in the transport chain cannot be identified.

values.name: Not loaded
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment to be loaded onto a means of transport have not been loaded on the expected transport.

values.name: On deck
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been stowed on deck.

values.name: Package not ready
values.description: The package was not available for collection.

values.name: Package tracking number unknown
values.description: The package tracking number is unknown.

values.name: Partly missing
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment are partly, but not completely, missing.

values.name: Payment not received
values.description: The expected payment for the transport action was not received.

values.name: Payment refused
values.description: The payer refused to pay for the service.

values.name: Plundered
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been plundered.

values.name: Refused without reason given
values.description: The transport action/documentation has been refused without explanation.

values.name: Scheduled past cut-off
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment to be delivered/collected have been scheduled past/later than the cut-off time.

values.name: Shunted to siding
values.description: The transport on which the goods/consignments/equipment is to be placed has been shunted to siding.

values.name: Sorted wrong route
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been sorted erroneously to an incorrect route.

values.name: Special service required
values.description: A special service is required for the goods/consignments/equipment.

values.name: Split
values.description: The consignment of goods has been split into two or more consignments.

values.name: Totally missing
values.description: The total goods/consignments/equipment is missing.

values.name: Tracking information unavailable
values.description: The tracking information of the goods/consignments/equipment is unavailable.

values.name: Transit delay
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been delayed in transit.

values.name: Unable to locate
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment cannot be located.

values.name: Unacceptable condition
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment were in unacceptable condition at time of delivery/collection.

values.name: Under deck
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been stowed under/below deck.

values.name: Unknown
values.description: The reason is unknown.

values.name: Weather conditions
values.description: The weather conditions have affected collection/delivery.

values.name: Expired free time
values.description: The goods/consignments/equipment have been in a storage facility for longer than permitted free time.

values.name: Outstanding claims settled
values.description: Outstanding claims in respect of goods/consignments/equipment have been settled.
